description: Defines the TimesheetItem entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a timesheet entry with properties like date, duration, comment, and associations to Timesheet, Project, ProjectActivity, and Employee.

classes.name: TimesheetItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet entry with properties for date, duration, comment, and relationships to other entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the timesheet item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the timesheet item.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with this entry.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this entry.

methods.name: setProjectActivity
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity entity with this entry.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this entry.
